name: vidmill
description: Open-source AI video editing toolkit: FFmpeg, Faster-Whisper, FaceFusion and DeepFilterNet exposed as connected CLI tools that any human or AI agent can orchestrate.
job_model: Tools read/write artifacts inside one job directory. Each tool consumes the job's current video artifact and records its output in job.json, so chains are resumable and inspectable with `vmill status`.

tools.name: probe
tools.purpose: Open a video as a job and record its media info (probe.json).

tools.name: transcribe
tools.purpose: Word-level transcript of the current video (transcript.json + srt).

tools.name: plan
tools.purpose: Build cut_plan.json: segments to keep/drop from silence detection + explicit/agent cuts.

inputs.--pad: keep this many seconds around speech

tools.name: cut
tools.purpose: Apply cut_plan.json to the current video -> cut.mp4 (trim+concat, audio kept in sync).

inputs.--plan-file: plan to apply (default: latest in job)

inputs.--engine: dfnet (DeepFilterNet env) or ffmpeg afftdn fallback

tools.name: captions
tools.purpose: Burn word-synced captions from transcript.json -> captioned.mp4.

tools.name: face
tools.cmd: vmill face --job <dir> --image face.jpg [--model inswapper_128] [--extra '...raw facefusion args...']
tools.purpose: Swap a reference face onto the current video (FaceFusion headless) -> swapped.mp4.

tools.name: music
tools.purpose: Curated no-copyright music & SFX: list, download into a job, mix under the video.
tools.engine: vidmill curated catalog (CC0 / Public Domain / CC BY, commercial-safe)

tools.name: auto
tools.purpose: Fully automatic edit with zero manual work: local free pass removes pauses, still segments and retakes, generates subtitles, cleans audio and exports. With --ai (and VIDMILL_AI_KEY set) makes ONE compact LLM call to suggest extra cuts; without a key it still delivers the free edit.
tools.engine: vidmill local engines + optional OpenAI-compatible checkpoint

tools.name: export
tools.purpose: Export the current video with a delivery preset -> final.mp4.

tools.name: pipeline
tools.purpose: Run a chain of tools in order, skipping steps whose artifacts already exist (resumable).

tools.name: status
tools.purpose: Show artifacts, media info and the tool history of a job.

tools.name: doctor
tools.purpose: Check which engines are installed and usable on this machine.
